verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a cross-cutting feature that any end-user app, including a 2FA authenticator, could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks inside Authy. The documented features cover only TOTP generation, multi-device sync, encrypted backup, and device management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
